issues.name: Dangling footnote markers glued to words
issues.description: Essays keep the superscript footnote numbers as plain digits glued to the preceding word or punctuation (e.g. 'circulation.1', 'Giedion1'), but the notes themselves are absent from the text. The model learns to put random digits at sentence ends. The filtered version does not change these.
issues.prevalence: 143/1412 docs (10.1%); 2,056 markers; 3,117 chars (0.045%). By type: essay 1976, conjecture 72, collection 8 matches. Precision: I read a seeded random sample of 40 matches and 40/40 were real footnote markers. During regex development, 1 earlier sampled match ('Fm7 arpeggios') was a false positive. Unchanged in the filtered version: 143 docs.

duplication: Exact duplicates: 0 groups. I hashed both the full text and the body (header removed) after NFKC normalization, lowercasing, quote normalization and whitespace collapse with SHA-1. Ids: 0 duplicate ids. Near duplicates: I used my own MinHash in numpy (datasketch is not installed): 128 multiply-add hashes mod 2^64 over blake2b-64 hashes of word 5-shingles of the body. All 996,166 pairs were compared. Pairs with estimated similarity of 0.3 or more were then verified with exact Jaccard. Results: 30 candidate pairs; 8 pairs with exact Jaccard of 0.5 or more; 0 pairs at 0.8 or more. The pairs fall into two kinds. (a) Re-posts of the same item: the-six-voyages-of-john-baptista-tavernier-1678 vs illustrations-from-the-six-voyages-of-john-baptista-tavernier-1678 (J=0.764, containment 0.954); cartoon-portraits-of-men-of-the-day-1873 vs cartoon-portraits-of-leading-19th-century-figures-1873 (J=0.69); phrenology-diagrams-from-vaught-s-practical-character-reader-1902 vs vaught-s-practical-character-reader-1902 (J=0.726); the-mechanism-of-human-physiognomy vs mecanisme-de-la-physionomie-humaine (J=0.416, containment 0.827); the-kiss-1896-film vs the-kiss-1896 (J=0.429, containment 1.0: the 2011 post is fully contained in the 2013 GIF post). (b) Similarity driven by boilerplate among the 8 Okkult GIF posts (e.g. hands-1944 vs the-knife-throwing-mother-1950, J=0.672). Rate: 8 of 1412 docs are in a pair with J of 0.5 or more after excluding the boilerplate-only cluster. I did not measure overlap with other sources (Wikipedia).
filtered_comparison: The filtered shard public-domain-review-0000.json.gz has 1406 docs and 6,939,288 chars, against 1412 docs and 6,964,459 chars in raw. Matched by id: 6 docs dropped, 0 added. Dropped: art-in-art (27 chars), men-in-wigs (29), what-to-draw-and-how-to-draw-it-1913 (55), a-little-wander-down-the-catwalk-of-time (61). These 4 have empty bodies. Also dropped: the-heart-in-art (89 chars, 1 sentence) and salome-with-john-the-baptist-s-head-at-the-rijksmuseum (1249 chars, a King James Bible quote of Mark 6:21-29 about a beheading). The data does not say why the Salome post was dropped (possibly a toxicity or length classifier; not verified). Dropped total: 1,510 chars. Kept docs: 1121 have identical text, 285 are modified. 284 differ only by removal of the license footer line ('The text of this essay is published under a CC BY-SA license, see here for details.'). 1 (the-primordial-gound) has the footer removed and one email address replaced with '<EMAIL_ADDRESS>', which also ate the space before it. 23,661 chars were removed from kept docs. No other field changed (added, author, date, source, type, license and url are all identical). metadata.provenance was added. Still present in the filtered version: \n{3,} runs (1128 docs), dangling footnote markers (143 docs), lost line breaks (86 docs), '(Wikipedia)' copied paragraphs (54 docs, 0.74% of chars), Okkult boilerplate (8 docs), short call-to-action lines (40 docs), media-navigation lines (9), the HTML anchor, Markdown link and URLs (1/1/3 docs), the residual masked email, 38 stub docs with a body under 200 chars, and the near-duplicate re-posts.
license_notes: metadata.license is 'Creative Commons - Attribution Share-Alike - https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/' for 1412/1412 docs, with no other value. metadata.url prefixes: publicdomainreview.org/collection/ 1127, publicdomainreview.org/essay/ 285. Using this data means meeting CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution and share-alike terms. Three things in the text bear on licensing. (1) The essay footer line confirms CC BY-SA for essay text. (2) 54 docs contain paragraphs copied from Wikipedia, which is also CC BY-SA. (3) Some posts quote modern copyrighted works at length: texts-in-sebald-s-the-rings-of-saturn quotes Sebald's 1995 book with page references such as '(pg.200/1)'. I did not measure the license status of quoted third-party passages.

recommended_steps.step: After the boilerplate is removed, deduplicate near-duplicate re-posts. Keep the longer doc of each pair with Jaccard of 0.5 or more on body 5-shingles, or containment of 0.8 or more.
